name: terraform-audit
description: Brutal, structured audit of a Terraform or OpenTofu module repository. Detects cross-module composition smells (overlap, duplication, thin wrappers, scope-discriminator primitives, copy-pasted module blocks, tier misplacement), cross-project / cross-account linking flaws, missing validations, dead code, version-pinning drift, and provider-specific landing-zone gaps (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI). Produces an 8-section critique with per-module grades and a concrete defect list, with optional baseline diff. Workflow at /terraform-audit:audit [path]. Bundles Anton Babenko's terraform-skill v1.6.0 (Apache-2.0) for canonical Terraform best-practices context.
